{{Quote|The Emperor's primary charge is to protect us, is it not? And that's what the P.O.R.D. legislation will do.|Vivyn|audio=Vivyn-Narkina5.flac|<ref name="Narkina5" />}}
'''Vivyn''' was a [[human]] [[senator]] in the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Shortly after [[Galactic Emperor]]<ref name="Narkina5" /> [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> introduced the [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]] in response to a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|rebel]] [[Aldhani heist|heist]] on<ref name="Narkina5" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Eye">{{Andor|The Eye}}</ref> [[Aldhani]]<ref name="Narkina5" /> in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|108}}</ref> Vivyn attended a party held at the [[Chandrilan Embassy]] on<ref name="Narkina5" /> the planet<ref name="USW" /> [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Narkina5" />

At the party, [[Chandrilan]] Senator [[Mon Mothma]] attempted to win votes to oppose the directive, holding a conversation with Vivyn, Senators [[Dhow]] and [[Teenar]], and the guest [[Slorda]]. Drink in hand, Vivyn claimed that the directive would protect them, as was the [[Emperor]]'s primary charge, and stated that they had already seen what too little protection looked like during what Vivyn considered to be dangerous [[time]]s. Vivyn then chuckled when Slorda changed the topic with a joke. Vivyn had light skin and [[Color|red]] [[hair]]. At the party, the senator wore a pink [[Clothing|dress]] with a golden [[necklace]] and matching earrings.<ref name="Narkina5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vivyn was portrayed by [[Alice Orr-Ewing]] in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," the eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Narkina5" /> which was aired on [[October 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> The character's name is not spoken in the episode, but is given in the episode's subtitles and credits. The credits list the character's name as "Senator Vivyn," while the subtitles spell it as "Vyvin."<ref name="Narkina5" />
